$comment: Release trend gate (specs/087-release-trend-gate). tools/release-ab.mjs runs the previous release's CLI and the candidate over every corpus directory and fails unless the CHANGELOG section being released names each finding code whose findings changed. A corpus entry is a path (`/*` expands to subdirectories) or { path, ignoreCodes }; a volatile code's message carries a date or timing, so it is compared by count only. Every ignored or volatile code needs a reason.

ignoreCodes.MET001: DocGuard's own docs state the candidate's validator and command counts, so the previous release's CLI disagrees with them by design
ignoreCodes.CSY002: DocGuard's own README states the candidate's command count, so the previous release's CLI disagrees with it by design
ignoreCodes.CSY004: DocGuard's own README diagram states the candidate's command count, so the previous release's CLI disagrees with it by design
ignoreCodes.SSY002: DocGuard's own README lists the candidate's commands and validators, which the previous release's CLI does not have
